field: Message to the Hiring Team - let the company know about your interest working there
notes: Netherlands, remote. Judgement call: this is Ashby generic message box, but the prompt literally asks him to state his interest in working there, which is a cover letter by another name, so his rule applies. If he would rather I treat a bare message box as not a cover letter, say so and this one goes out in two minutes. Everything else on it is trivial: name, email, nationality, country, phone, LinkedIn, CV and a work-visa yes or no.
